comment: Farasan is a hidden gem for divers. The coral reefs are pristine and the seafood is the best in the Kingdom.
Waking up above the clouds in Fayfa is a dream. The view from the top is definitely worth the trip.
The Heritage Village is very interesting. It shows a unique side of Saudi culture that is very authentic.
The beaches are very quiet and beautiful. A perfect place for those looking for untouched nature.
